text:
eva-marketing: Heads up  small plan to rework launch newsletter + benchmark send to reduce overlap with webinar invites. Thoughts?
ryan-growth: Good. We saw spike in unsubscribers when users got 3 emails in 9 days. Need suppression.
mira-analytics: Quick numbers: paid_trial_new=9.8k, conference_leads=1.9k. Overlap where welcome+benchmark+webinar hit within 7 days ~11%. SQL snippet I'm using attached to the doc.
tom-campaigns: Proposal: stagger sends: welcome D0, tips D3, benchmark D7 (conditional), webinar D14 (conditional). Add suppression if opened any email in last 72h or triggered onboarding_event in last 48h.
isa-sales: Also: if sales_contacted=true then skip webinar and send sales follow-up instead. We can't mix product emails with active sales outreach.
eva-marketing: A/B test idea: benchmark D7 vs D10 for paid cohort only, 15% holdout. Measure: 7d unsub, reg-rate, demo-requests.
mira-analytics: I'll prepare suppression lists and cohort splits. Tom, can you update the Braze flows to include the new suppression list name 'post_launch_recent_engaged'?
tom-campaigns: Yep. Will stage changes in staging and run a dry send to the test list tomorrow. Also will add an ops blackout rule for billing windows.
automation-bot: Campaign plan created: marketing/campaigns/post-launch-stagger-v2 scheduled for 2026-03-29T04:00:00Z (dry-run)yan-growth: Assignments: Mira (cohorts + metrics), Tom (flows + staging), Isa (confirm SFDC sales_contacted sync), Eva (A/B specs + launch calendar).
eva-marketing: Thanks team. Reconvene in next sync to confirm counts and start date. :sparkles:
